payload.blocks: Phase 2a (delete src/setup/agent-hooks.mjs), and through it 2b. Every other open phase continues.

parts.cause: Lead-checked with rg at 20ad16de0: test/live/mailbox-claude.live.mjs:79 and :576 import installClaudeHook, installCodexHook and checkClaudeHook; test/live/mailbox-behaviour.live.mjs:70 imports installOmpHook and installPiHook; test/architecture.test.mjs:2142 seeds the path; door rows retired-node-s5-hook-script.yaml and writer-and-session-id-environment.yaml list it as allowed, and delete-guard-keyword-list.yaml carries a debt entry for it. options.cost: A footprint edit of six paths by the planner or supervisor, then one unit of about 100 lines.
options.does: Adds test/live/mailbox-claude.live.mjs, test/live/mailbox-behaviour.live.mjs, test/architecture.test.mjs and the three door rows to phase 2a. The unit re-points the two live scripts onto the Rust hook installer (fgos wire-agents) and deletes the Node table in the same commit.
options.gain: 2a and 2b finish in this plan, with no twin left (CA-D2), as the owner's 2026-11-23 decision intends.
options.harm: test/architecture.test.mjs is also phase 10's file, so 2a and 10 must not run at once. If wire-agents cannot target a temporary workspace, the unit stops and reports that, and a second question follows.
options.label: A. Widen 2a by exactly those six files

options.cost: No work now; one line in phase 10's named-debt list.

parts.recommendation: A: the owner already chose deletion, the callers are six known files, and B leaves the twin alive.
